Accenture Adjusts Salary Hike Policy for Broader Employee Coverage

Accenture has revised its salary hike policy to include a larger number of employees in the June cycle, with the new approach splitting base pay and one-time lump sums. This change aims to reward more staff while managing payroll. The move is part of Accenture's efforts to adapt to changing workforce dynamics.
